from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class HousingDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """A single housing start data point extracted from one document."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data refers to (YYYY-MM format)")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The housing starts value as a float")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the value (e.g., 'thousands', 'units', 'actual')")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the document containing this data (YYYY-MM-DD), used for precedence")
    status: str | None = Field(description="Status of the data in this report (e.g., 'preliminary', 'revised')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    housing_data_points: list[HousingDataPoint]
